name: Non-Root User
description: Create a named non-root passwd user for images that only provide root or a numeric runtime UID.

username.description: Username to create when it does not already exist.

user_uid.description: Optional numeric UID for the created user. Leave as automatic to let the system choose.

user_gid.description: Optional numeric GID for the created user's primary group. Leave as automatic to let the system choose.

user_home.description: Home directory for the created user. Leave as automatic to use /home/<username>.

user_shell.description: Login shell for the created user. Leave as automatic to prefer /bin/bash when present and fall back to /bin/sh.
